page.content:
Companions who journey with the Black Swordsman.

Key threads from this canonical page lead to Guts, Schierke, Isidro, Serpico, Farnese de Vandimion and Puck. Each link is another long-tail path through the subject.

How Guts's traveling party connects

These mapped links are unique to this page — each one is another long-tail route through the subject graph.

  • Led By: Guts — Guts leads his traveling companions.
  • Has Member: Schierke — Schierke joins Guts's party.
  • Has Member: Isidro — Isidro joins Guts's party.
  • Has Member: Serpico — Serpico joins Guts's party.
  • Has Member: Farnese de Vandimion — Farnese joins Guts's party.
  • Has Member: Puck — Puck is in Guts's party.
  • Connected To: Casca — Guts's traveling party is connected to Casca through shared lore.

Every edge is another route through the subject. Expand a group to see how these threads fit together.

Schierke Schierke is a young 'witch-in-training', and was once a disciple of the witch Flora. She is a member of Guts' Traveling Party. Isidro Isidro is a young runaway thief who joins Guts in his travels as a member of the swordsman's traveling party. Serpico Serpico is Farnese's servant and personal bodyguard. He is the illegitimate son of the noble Federico III of the Vandimion family who joins Guts' traveling party along with his half-sister Farnese.
